notes.title: Pretty Girls Card Game : Palette Bundle Out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821061/8745dd29518a6163068f1e5d0325d4844c8fffe2.png

Thank you for always playing "Pretty Girls" series!
We are pleased to inform you that we have released a great bundle pack.

This bundle pack contains the Pretty Girls card game series.
Let's enjoy the card games as much as you want with cute beautiful girls!

◆Pretty Girls Card Game : Palette Bundle
Titles included in the bundle:

Pretty Girls Klondike Solitaire
Pretty Girls Klondike Solitaire PLUS
Pretty Girls Four Kings Solitaire
Pretty Girls Speed
Poker Pretty Girls Battle
Poker Pretty Girls Battle : Fantasy World Edition

You can get a 30% bundle discount on this bundle pack.
For details, please check here.

We look forward to working with you in the future.
